title: Start a side business
tagline: Your salary stays, your side business starts right: account, invoices and taxes sorted from the first client.
trigger: Your salary keeps coming in, and a first client pays you next to it, or you registered a business number.

steps.title: Side business or main business?
steps.description: What changes when you work for yourself next to your job (bijberoep): social contributions, VAT and the tax on your side income.
steps.why: Based on your own salary and the first payments for your work. Nothing is shared.

win.customer: Started as a side business, not by accident

steps.result: Checked: your salary continues, so you start as a side business. Social contributions only apply above a minimum side income (illustrative; verify the 2026 threshold).

steps.title: A separate account for the side business
steps.description: A business account and card, so side income and costs never mix with your household money.
steps.why: Separate money makes your tax return and VAT simple.

win.customer: Business and private apart from day one

steps.result: Business account opened. Your side income now lands there.

steps.title: Invoices the right way (Peppol)
steps.description: Peppol e-invoices to your business clients, linked to your business account.
steps.why: Belgian B2B invoices go over Peppol. Billit only receives your name, e-mail and company number.
steps.result: Billit account linked. Your next invoice goes out over Peppol.

steps.title: A pot for the tax on your side income
steps.description: A fixed share of every side payment moves to a savings pot, for the extra tax and contributions.
steps.why: Side income is taxed on top of your salary, so the rate is often higher than people expect.

win.customer: No surprise in next year's tax bill

steps.result: Tax pot set: 35% of every side payment is put aside automatically (illustrative).

steps.title: Cover for mistakes in your work
steps.description: Professional liability insurance for the side activity: your employer's policy doesn't cover it.
steps.why: One claim from a client can cost more than a year of side income.
steps.result: Professional liability cover active for your side activity.
